additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / S4 170003556
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
YDRDYE
Problem Description
: F/W never gets pushed out
Troubleshooting
:
Thank you for submitting the ticket. The download time may vary depending on the network strength near the charger. The firmware version is approximately 3GB in size. Upon reviewing the logs, I noticed that the RSRP parameter for router1 data is around -97. This indicates as highlighted below. We advise you to be patient, and once the download is complete, we can proceed with activating the latest firmware version.
Reliable data speeds may be attained, but marginal data with drop-outs is possible. When this value gets close to -100, performance will drop drastically
For future reference, your ticket number is
0382569
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
